_doc.purpose: Phase-quick 260805-tnufa-graphrag-grant-grader: the grant-program rubric fixture contract. One JSON Schema, N per-program fixture files under data/grant-rubric-fixtures/*.json -- mirrors the data/hitl-stages-schema.json + data/hitl-stages-fixtures/*.json shape (Canon Part 7 reuse-before-build). Adding a new IIA grant program's full criteria later is a new fixture file, never new code.
_doc.canon_part8: This whole reference pack is real domain/product data (Israel Innovation Authority grant specifics), NOT generic PWS methodology. It ships LOCAL, bundled with the plugin install, and is NEVER pushed to the shared Brain -- confirmed empirically this session when a brain_search for Tnufa content was blocked by the Part 8 egress guard as out of scope for the generic-methodology graph.
_doc.source: Notion 'Tnufa grant how-to?' page (PWS Backoffice > Databases > Management > Problem solvers > Library) + its 'IIA Grants' database + Chapter 9 ('A Complete Guide to the Tnufa Grant') from the full page export. See references/opportunities/tnufa-rubric.md for the full provenance and the matching-fund contradiction-resolution note.
_doc.default_on_miss: reject (fail closed): a fixture missing a required field, or a criterion with an unknown category, is a hard error at load time, not a silent pass.

record_contract.name_he: <Hebrew program name (מסלול), when known -- empty string if not yet captured>
record_contract.stage: <one of: Pre-Seed | Seed | Round A | Seed/Early | All stages>
record_contract.funding_pct: <string, e.g. 'up to 85%' -- kept as a string since source values are ranges/qualifiers, not bare numbers>
record_contract.status: <one of: stub | drafted | reviewed -- the fixture's OWN completeness state, distinct from the IIA program's own lifecycle>

criteria.details: <what a strong application does on this dimension>
criteria.common_mistake: <the named failure mode from source material>
criteria.category: <one of: eligibility | process | budget | legal | reporting | market | ip>

validation_rule: A fixture is valid when: id/name_en/stage/eligibility/purpose/funding_pct/funding_cap/duration/status are all non-empty strings; status is a member of {stub, drafted, reviewed}; criteria is an array (possibly empty for a stub fixture); every criteria[] entry has a non-empty id/aspect/details/common_mistake and a category in category_vocabulary.
